blocks.arabic_text: سَبِيلِ اللهِ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ وَمَنْ خَلَفَ غَازِياً فِي أَهْلِهِ بِخَيْرٍ، وَأَنْفَقَ عَلي أَهْلِهِ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ورجاله رجال الصحيح، مجمع الزوائد:٥١٥/٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Zaid ibn Thabit (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever makes the travel arrangements of one going out in the path of Allah Ta'ala will receive a reward equal to that of the one who went out in the path of Allah Ta'ala. And whoever stands by the family of one who has gone in the path of Allah Ta'ala and spends on them will also receive a reward equal to that of the one who went out in the path of Allah Ta'ala.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: حُرْمَةُ نِسَاءِ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ عَلَي الْقَاعِدِينَ كَحُرْمَةِ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ، وَإِذَا خَلَفَهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ فَخَانَهُ قِيلَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: هذَا خَانَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ فَخُذْ مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ مَا شِئْتَ، فَمَا ظَنُّكُمْ؟
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي، باب من خان غازيا في اهله، رقم:٣١٩٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Those who stay behind in the town must honour the wives of those who have gone in the path of Allah Ta'ala just as one honours one's own mother. (Therefore, special attention must be given to protecting the honour and dignity of the wives of those who have gone in the path of Allah Ta'ala.) If one who is going in the path of Allah Ta'ala appoints someone as a guardian over his wife and children and goes, and after he has gone this person harms the honour and dignity of his wife and children, then on the Day of Qiyamah it will be said, “This is the one who behaved improperly with your family, so take as much as you want from his good deeds,”
